svg.title: Hexagonal architecture diagram showing Controller to RepositoryPort to Adapter flow
svg.desc: Three-layer hexagonal architecture: inbound layer with ReservationController, application layer with RepositoryPort interfaces, and outbound layer with RestaurantTableRepositoryAdapter and TableRepositoryAdapter connected to JPA repositories

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does RestaurantTableRepositoryPort do in hexagonal architecture?')
sendPrompt('What does TableRepositoryPort do in hexagonal architecture?')
sendPrompt('What does ReservationController do in this hexagonal architecture?')
sendPrompt('What does RestaurantTableRepositoryAdapter do in hexagonal architecture?')
sendPrompt('What does TableRepositoryAdapter do in hexagonal architecture?')
